d:
What is really happening inside Pakistan-Occupied Kashmir? Why are thousands of people protesting, and why has this issue received so little global attention?
In this video, Abhi and Niyu break down the political unrest in POJK—from controversial election rules and public protests to the region's strategic importance, control over natural resources, and the growing disconnect between the people and the establishment. We also examine how media narratives shape global opinion and the key lessons India can learn from its neighbour.
